place: HackLab #2, CIC Berlin, table by the window

layout.keyboard: Arturia MicroLab, 25 keys C3-C5, octave buttons at default (middle C = C4 = MIDI 60). Stickers 1-6 on the bass, C3 D3 E3 F3 G3 A3 (white keys 1 to 6 from the left, seen from the player's side), stickers 7-12 on the melody, C4 D4 E4 F4 G4 A4 (white keys 8 to 13). See keys_layout.json.
layout.arm: SO-101 follower on the player's side of the keyboard (away from the window), reaching over the keys toward Reachy.
layout.reachy: Reachy Mini behind the keyboard on the window side, facing the player, centred on the sticker keys, about 25-30 cm from the keyboard's back edge.
layout.tape: Tape down the keyboard, the arm's base and Reachy's base before teaching poses. Mark their corners on the table so they can be put back.

reachy_head.note: Saved after the Reachy app restarted. The head has 5 to 10 degrees of play on re-command (most in roll), so set it once and leave it: keep Reachy powered and its app running from recording to the end of the demo. lock approaches from above and from the +roll side and sends nothing while the head is still in place. Angles in radians, positions in metres.

check: Before recording or a demo: compare Reachy's view with rig/view_policy.jpg (keys_camera_serve.py serves it at http://127.0.0.1:8790/policy.jpg). Do not run keys_ui.py or keys_voice.py during recording: they move the head.
